# Niche packs — woodworking (for the `thumbnails` skill)

Loaded by the `thumbnails` skill as standing context when a channel is named. Fields: character, common objects / materials / settings, banned items, style tweaks.

**Status: DRAFT — every pack is `endorsed`-pending.** The pre-Session-0 files held no thumbnail packs; these are drafted from persona and topic data. Known thumbnail evidence: the own winners clicked on a sharp specific text hook ("STOP GLUE STAINS"); ecosystem winners used "DON'T DO IT", "99% DON'T KNOW THESE", "Don't Throw It Away", "WORTH IT".

## Dale Oakfield's Workshop (woodworking for profit — pivoted 2026-09-09)

- **Character:** the Dale Oakfield on-camera AI-avatar presenter (Talking Head since 2026-10-20) — **description pending from the operator**. Until supplied, use a presenter-left composition and treat the avatar as the character.
- **Common objects / materials / settings:** raw pine and construction 2x4s, oak and walnut boards, table saw, miter saw, clamps, chisels, wood glue, sawdust piles, offcut bins, jigs; cutting boards; a home garage workshop with a plain plywood bench. Contrast rule matters doubly here — never wood-on-matching-wood; light wood on a dark bench or dark wood on a pale wall.
- **Banned items:** brand logos (default off); faces other than the avatar; any depiction of the avatar demonstrating technique; whole-room shots; matching-wood backgrounds.
- **Style tweaks:** documentary realism; the "cutout on void" tool-review style allowed only for tool-buying titles (F8 / F28 / F13 — now a parked lane); text hooks short and specific.
- **For-profit additions (2026-09-09):** the proof moment is **product + price** — the "$6 → $200" split, a finished piece beside the single 2x4 it came from, a market table stacked with smalls, a "SOLD OUT" or "SOLD" tag; cash, price tags and a card reader are on-brand here (unlike the pre-pivot pack); ecosystem thumbnail hooks seen on the intake: "MAKE YOUR MONEY", "QUICK ENOUGH", the "$475" callout, "$45 each".

## Master Kenji

- **Character:** none by default. If hands are wanted: precise, clean hands, dark plain sleeve. (Confirm.)
- **Common objects / materials / settings:** kanna (Japanese plane), ryoba / dozuki saws, chisels, waterstones, kumiko lattice, clean hinoki / cedar / walnut, mortise-and-tenon and dovetail joints shown as the hero; a calm, uncluttered bench, plain pale wall.
- **Banned items:** big-box packaging, power-tool clutter, price tags, bargain graphics; anything that reads as thrift; faces.
- **Style tweaks:** precision and calm — one joint or one edge fills the frame; mirror-finish and hairline-gap details as the proof moment; muted, orderly palette.

## Sawdust Sam (woodworking for profit, the old-world way — face, relaunched 2026-10-23)

- **Character:** the Sawdust Sam AI-avatar presenter — **description pending from the operator** (a `sam.png` sits in the channel's Drive edit-assets folder). Until supplied, use a presenter-left composition and treat the avatar as the character.
- **Common objects / materials / settings:** the finished heritage-style piece as the hero (the Amish-style bench, the Japanese-style box, the Chinese-style lantern) on a market table or bench beside its price; old hand tools as accents (hand plane, drawknife, mallet); a plain-board workshop, natural window light (still bright and even per the thumbnails rulebook).
- **Banned items:** brand logos (default off); any depiction of the avatar demonstrating technique; faces other than the avatar; costume, caricature or stereotype of any culture; flat-pack furniture except as the villain in a split.
- **Style tweaks:** old-world piece + price is the proof moment; money cues welcome; the heritage shows in the piece's shape, joint or pattern, said respectfully; no "BANNED" or "scientists say" text hooks.
